_comment: Phase 1 of the crosswalk pipeline (Operations/research/crosswalk-pipeline/crosswalk-pipeline-design.md): the draft pharmacy crosswalk tabs are sourced from THIS versioned repo file, not the Google Sheet. scripts/generateCrosswalk.js reads these 2D-array rows (header + data rows, same shape parseCSV yields for Sheet tabs) and renders them into the AUTO-GENERATED block of crosswalk.mdx. Carrier data is accuracy-first. Humana is illustrative (from the public pharmacy module example modules/pharmacy/v0.2.0/examples/humana_part_d_example.json; verify against a real Humana Part D EOC before relying on it). Blue Cross is populated from a verified extraction of a public 2025 Florida Blue ACA SBC (BlueCare 14256 HMO; Florida Blue is an independent BCBS licensee), verified live 2026-07-03. Coverage Stages stay blank for Blue Cross because commercial ACA plans have no Part D style stages. All other carriers are blank pending verified public sources. tier_code values are canonical FHIR DrugTierVS. Drug-level formulary data is intentionally absent (its source is formulary files, not SBCs).

Pharmacy Tiers: generic_drugs__preventive; generic_drugs__condition_care_rx; generic_drugs; preferred_brand_drugs__condition_care_rx; preferred_brand_drugs; nonpreferred_brand_drugs; specialty_drugs (Florida Blue, public 2025 SBC)
T1; T2; T3; T4; T5 (Humana, illustrative)
Generic Drugs (Preventive; Condition Care Rx; All Other) … Specialty Drugs (Florida Blue, public 2025 SBC)

Preventive; Condition Care Rx; All Other Generic; All Other Preferred Brand; Non-preferred brand drugs; Specialty drugs (Florida Blue, public 2025 SBC)
